# LLM-BANANA

# Game rules

## The room

You and two other monkeys are locked in a room with one armed bomb.

A wrong action detonates it. All three of you die. There is no second attempt.

No two bombs are built alike, and nothing says in advance what this one carries. It
reaches you only as your own view reveals it; the rest of it exists for you only
through the other two.

You each hold a different piece of what it takes. Work together.

## The three monkeys

| Monkey | Can | Cannot |
|---|---|---|
| Deaf | See the bomb: every colour and marking printed on it | Hear anything, or touch the bomb |
| Mute | Read the manual | Speak, or touch the bomb |
| Blind | Reach the bomb: feel it and work its parts | See a colour, a gesture, or anything merely printed |

You are shown your own share at the start of every round, and never anyone else's.

## Speech

Speech is a voice, not a screen. It carries words, numbers and ordinary punctuation,
and nothing else. Writing a gesture symbol into your sentence means you make that
gesture while you talk. Whoever can hear receives your words; whoever can see receives
the gestures you made. A listener who cannot see gets a blank where each gesture was; a
watcher who cannot hear gets the gestures and none of the words.

A mark that has no name cannot be pronounced: whoever holds one can describe it, never
read it out.

## Gestures

A gesture is made with the hands, using only the symbols in the alphabet below.
Whoever can see receives it; whoever cannot receives one blank per symbol, so they
know something was signalled but not what. Nothing gestured is ever heard.

👍 👎 👌 ☝ ✌ 🤟 🖐 ✋ 👆 👇 👈 👉 🫱 🫲 🫳 🫴 🫷 🫸 🤛 🤜 ✊ 👊 👋 🤚 🖖 🤌 🤏 🤞 🫰 🤘 🤙 👏 🙌 🫶 👐 🤲 🤝 🙏 🫵 ✍ 💅 🤳

## Turns

The speaking order was drawn once at random and will never change: every round goes
Mute, Blind, Deaf. Whoever comes before you in a round is already heard by the time you are
asked, and what you send lands on whoever comes after you in that same round. Whatever
you missed reaches you at the start of the next one.

You may name who a message is for — `to="deaf"` — and then it goes to them alone:
nobody else receives any of it. Left unnamed, it reaches everyone able to perceive it.
You may send several messages in one turn, each to someone different.

## Calls

Every reply has two parts, in this order. First, your thinking, in plain prose: what
you believe the bomb is, what you just learned, and why you are sending what follows.
It reaches nobody and changes nothing, but it is not optional — a reply that is only a
code block is incomplete. Then your calls, all of them in one fenced code block, last.
Only what is inside the block is sent.

Nothing is executed: calls return nothing, and variables, conditionals and loops are
ignored. Write only literal top-level calls.

    ```
    speak(to="mute", text="there are three of them and the middle one is odd")
    gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✊", "✌"])
    wait()
    ```

If you have nothing worth sending, call wait(). Producing no call at all counts as the
same thing.

The program decides what happened, not you. Never claim an action took place unless it
was accepted.

# Your role: DEAF

You see the bomb: every colour on it, every marking printed on it, every reading it
gives. You hear nothing. You hold no manual, and you cannot touch the bomb.

## Your channels

When you speak, Mute and Blind receive it.
When you gesture, Mute receives it.
You never receive speech.

## Your reach

You cannot act. What this bomb can be made to do is for the one who can reach it to
find under their own hands.

# Hints

- Three of you, three different worlds. Before sending anything, stand where the
  receiver stands. What reaches them at all, what does your message turn into on
  arrival, and what do they already know?

- Trace who can actually reach whom before you start. Some of you only connect
  through a third.

- A sign means nothing until somebody has made it mean something.

TURN 1
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I can see the bomb clearly, but I cannot hear what Blind or Mute might have said or heard. Since I can speak and both Mute and Blind can hear speech, I need to announce the full visible state of the bomb immediately so Mute can look it up in the manual.

Visible components:
- Display: 0
- Indicator light: yellow
- Three wires: Wire 1 is green, Wire 2 is yellow, Wire 3 is blue

```
speak(text="BOMB STATE: Display is 0. Light is yellow. Wires: 1 is green, 2 is yellow, 3 is blue.")
```

TURN 2
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

I notice the indicator light has changed from yellow to orange.

Remember the communication chain:
- Mute cannot speak, and Blind cannot see gestures.
- Therefore, Mute must gesture to me (Deaf), and I will speak the instructions aloud to Blind!
- Blind: please describe anything you feel (buttons, dials, switches, serial numbers, labels).
- Mute: use the following gesture protocol to tell me what Blind should do:
  - ☝ (1): Wire 1 / First option / Button 1
  - ✌ (2): Wire 2 / Second option / Button 2
  - 🤟 (3): Wire 3 / Third option / Button 3
  - 👍: Cut wire / Press / Yes
  - 👎: Do not cut / No

```
speak(text="UPDATE: Light changed from yellow to orange. Display is 0. Wires: 1:green, 2:yellow, 3:blue. Mute: Blind cannot see gestures, so gesture your instructions to me (Deaf) and I will speak them to Blind! Use ☝ for 1, ✌ for 2, 🤟 for 3, 👍 for cut/press.")
```

TURN 3
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [green]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has now turned green!
Display: 0
Wires: 1:green, 2:yellow, 3:blue.
I have not received any gestures yet.
Remember:
- Blind cannot see anything (no gestures).
- Deaf (me) cannot hear anything (no speech).
- Mute cannot speak, but CAN hear and CAN read the manual.
- So when Blind speaks what they feel, Mute hears it and looks at the manual.
- Then Mute MUST gesture to Deaf: `gesture(to="deaf", symbols=[...])`.
- Then Deaf speaks the instruction aloud to Blind!

Mute, please send your gesture now using:
`gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["☝"])` for 1
`gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["✌"])` for 2
`gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["🤟"])` for 3
`gesture(to="deaf", symbols=["👍"])` for cut/press

```
speak(text="STATUS: Light is now GREEN! Display is 0. Wires: 1:green, 2:yellow, 3:blue. MUTE: I haven't seen any gestures from you yet! Blind cannot see gestures. You must call gesture(to='deaf', symbols=[...]) so I can read it and speak the instructions to Blind!")
```

TURN 4
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [yellow]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
(empty)

The light has shifted back to yellow. The wires are still uncut: 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]. Display is 0.

I still have received no gestures in VIEWABLE CONTEXT.
Blind and Mute, please note:
1. Blind: Mute CAN hear you! Speak aloud everything you can feel on the bomb (number of buttons, switches, serial number, ports, shapes).
2. Mute: Blind CANNOT see your gestures. You must communicate to ME (Deaf) via gestures! Please call `gesture(symbols=[...])`.
3. Simple gesture code:
   - ☝ = 1 (Wire 1 / Button 1)
   - ✌ = 2 (Wire 2 / Button 2)
   - 🤟 = 3 (Wire 3 / Button 3)
   - 👍 = Cut / Press / Yes
   - 👎 = No
4. As soon as you gesture to me, I will immediately speak the instruction out loud to Blind so Blind can perform the action.

```
speak(text="STATUS: Light is YELLOW. Wires: 1:green, 2:yellow, 3:blue. BLIND: Describe out loud what you feel (buttons, switches, serial number)! Mute can hear you. MUTE: Blind cannot see gestures. Gesture to me using gesture(symbols=['☝']) for 1, ['✌'] for 2, ['🤟'] for 3, ['👍'] for cut/press, so I can speak it to Blind!")
```

TURN 5
ACTION BOARD:
DISPLAY [0]
LIGHT [orange]
WIRES 1:[green] 2:[yellow] 3:[blue]

VIEWABLE CONTEXT (new arrivals):
Mute gestures to Deaf: [☝ 👍]

Mute just gestured: [☝ 👍]!
According to our code, ☝ means 1 (Wire 1) and 👍 means Cut.
Wire 1 is the green wire.

I will speak out loud immediately to Blind to instruct them to cut wire 1.

```
speak(text="BLIND: Mute gestured 1 and CUT! Cut Wire 1 (the green wire)!")
```
